meta.name: acquire-codebase-knowledge
meta.description: Use this skill when the user explicitly asks to map, document, or onboard into an existing codebase. Trigger for prompts like "map this codebase", "document this architecture", "onboard me to this repo", or "create codebase docs". Do not trigger for routine feature implementation, bug fixes, or narrow code edits unless the user asks for repository-level discovery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速理解并记录任意代码库的结构与逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的代码库，需要快速理清架构。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand and document any codebase's structure and logic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar codebase and need to quickly grasp its architecture.

howto.what: Claude会扫描你的项目代码，生成七份技术文档（STACK.md、STRUCTURE.md等）保存到docs/codebase/目录，只记录从文件和终端输出能确认的事实，未知标记[TODO]，需你决定处标[ASK USER]，最后给出总结和待确认问题。
howto.when: 当你明确要求Claude分析、记录或了解一个代码库时触发，例如说“梳理这个代码库”、“生成项目文档”、“介绍这个项目架构”等。日常功能开发不触发。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个代码库的结构
生成这个项目的技术文档
say.note: 同上，但可指定关注点如架构

say.text: 介绍一下这个项目的架构和依赖

howto.what_en: Claude scans your project codebase and generates seven documents (STACK.md, STRUCTURE.md, etc.) in docs/codebase/, recording only verifiable facts from files or terminal output, marking unknowns as [TODO] and team-intent gaps as [ASK USER], then presents a summary and a list of questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask Claude to map, document, or onboard into an existing codebase, e.g., saying "map this codebase", "document this architecture", or "onboard me to this repo". Not for routine feature work.

say_en.text: Map this codebase and generate docs
Generate technical documentation for this project
say_en.note: Same as above, can focus on specific areas
